title: Versive is now free to start, with surveys on every plan
summary: Sign up for the new Free plan and run surveys with no credit card. Every plan now includes surveys too, with their own allowance separate from AI credits.
body_markdown:
[Back to updates](https://www.getversive.com/blog)


September 23, 2026 •


Product Updates


### Versive is now free to start, with surveys on every plan


Sign up for the new Free plan and run surveys with no credit card. Every plan now includes surveys too, with their own allowance separate from AI credits.


---


Starting today, you can use Versive for free. The new **Free plan** lets anyone sign up and run surveys with no credit card and no trial clock. And **surveys are now part of every plan** , with their own allowance that's separate from your AI credits.


### A new Free plan


The Free plan is built for surveys. It includes 100 survey responses a month, up to 20 questions per survey, and one seat, with no credit card required and no end date.


The AI side of Versive (AI-moderated interviews, AI tests, AI personas, insights, and the[Versive Assistant](https://www.getversive.com/blog/september-2026-versive-assistant) ) is visible on Free so you can see what's there, and unlocks when you upgrade. Pro comes with a 14-day free trial, and the[pricing page](https://www.getversive.com/pricing) has the current allowances for each plan.


### Surveys on every plan


Not every question needs an AI interviewer. Sometimes you want a quick read on a feature list, a pulse check on onboarding, or a screener for your next round of interviews, and a straightforward survey is the right tool.


That's why every plan now comes with a monthly allowance of survey responses, counted separately from AI credits. Running a survey never eats into the credits you've set aside for AI-moderated interviews, so you can field a quick survey and an interview study side by side without trading one against the other.


A survey on Versive is a study built from structured questions, with no AI interviewer. It uses the same builder as the rest of Versive, so you get:


- **Every structured question type** : multiple choice, rating scales, NPS, matrices, rankings, card sorts, allocation, conjoint, dates, open text, and more.
- **Logic** : skip logic to route and screen participants, and[display logic](https://docs.getversive.com/studies/logic) to show a question only to the people it applies to.
- **Structure and experiments** : question groups with randomized order,[split tests](https://www.getversive.com/blog/september-2026-split-tests) to compare versions, and[quotas](https://www.getversive.com/blog/september-2026-quotas) to stop at the right number of completes.
- **Distribution** : share a link, track participants with unique links, or embed the survey in your product.
- **Results** : every response in the results grid, ready to filter and export to CSV.
- **Your AI tools** : build surveys and pull results from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor through the[Versive MCP server](https://www.getversive.com/blog/august-2026-mcp-server) .


When a survey needs more depth, change its study type to AI-moderated and add questions where the AI asks follow-ups, without rebuilding anything.


### If you're already a customer


Your current plan keeps its limits and pricing, and the new lineup applies if you change plans. If you'd like surveys added to your existing plan sooner,[let us know](https://www.getversive.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e98180a98e8c9d9f8c9b9a809f8cc78a8684) .


### Getting started


Sign up and you land straight in your dashboard. Choose **Survey** in the create dialog, or start from one of our[study templates](https://www.getversive.com/help/templates) . The[docs](https://docs.getversive.com/getting-started/concepts) explain how survey responses are counted.
